title: Advances in Management of Atrial Fibrillation With Tachycardia-Bradycardia Syndrome.
summary: Tachycardia-bradycardia syndrome (TBS), characterized by prolonged sinus pauses following termination of supraventricular tachyarrhythmias (predominantly atrial fibrillation), presents two primary curative strategies: catheter ablation (CA) and pacemaker implantation (PMI). Current guidelines (2024 ESC) recommend CA as a Class IIa intervention to improve symptoms and avoid PMI. Nevertheless, a significant proportion of patients (7.4%-22.4%) still require PMI after CA, primarily due to underlying intrinsic sinus node dysfunction (SND). Several predictors of PMI after CA have been reported, including preprocedural bradycardia-related symptoms, prolonged corrected sinus node recovery time (cSNRT > 550 ms), longer posttachycardia pauses (> 6.3 s), daytime occurrence of the longest sinus pause, autonomic markers such as heart rate variability (HRV), right atrial remodeling reflected by an increased right-to-left atrial volume index ratio (RAVI/LAVI ratio > 0.812), elevated E/Em, atrial or perinodal fibrosis, atrioventricular conduction disease, and procedure-related sinus node artery injury. Most proposed thresholds were derived from retrospective or single-center cohorts and require prospective external validation. This review summarizes current evidence regarding the bidirectional interaction between atrial fibrillation (AF) and SND, distinguishes potentially reversible AF-mediated or vagally mediated SND from intrinsic SND, and proposes a practical treatment-oriented risk stratification framework. This framework classifies patients into three phenotypes: those likely to improve with CA alone, those at high risk of requiring PMI after CA, and those with vagally mediated functional SND who may be candidates for cardioneuroablation (CNA). Emerging strategies, including CNA, conduction system pacing (CSP), leadless pacemakers (LPMs), and biological pacemakers, may further refine individualized management. Future prospective multicenter studies are needed to validate integrated predictive models.

AI.tldr: 房颤伴快慢综合征患者中，导管消融可作为改善症状、避免起搏器植入的一线策略，但7.4%-22.4%患者术后仍需起搏器，需基于预测因素进行风险分层。
AI.motivation: 快慢综合征（TBS）以房颤等房性快速性心律失常终止后出现长窦性停搏为特征，当前指南推荐导管消融（IIa类）改善症状并避免起搏器植入，但部分患者消融后仍因内在窦房结功能障碍需起搏器，如何识别这些患者并优化个体化治疗是临床亟待解决的问题。
AI.method: 本文为综述，总结房颤与窦房结功能障碍双向交互的现有证据，区分可逆性房颤介导或迷走介导的窦房结功能障碍与内在性窦房结功能障碍，并提出以治疗为导向的风险分层框架，将患者分为三类表型：可能仅通过消融改善者、消融后高概率需起搏器者、迷走介导功能性窦房结功能障碍可能适合心脏神经消融者。
AI.result: 综述汇总了消融后需起搏器的预测因素，包括术前心动过缓相关症状、校正窦房结恢复时间延长（cSNRT > 550 ms）、心动过速后停搏较长（> 6.3 s）、最长窦性停搏发生于日间、自主神经标志物如心率变异性、右心房重构（右/左心房容积指数比 > 0.812）、E/Em升高、心房或结周纤维化、房室传导疾病以及手术相关的窦房结动脉损伤；多数阈值来自回顾性或单中心队列，需前瞻性外部验证。
AI.conclusion: 导管消融是TBS患者改善症状、避免起搏器的重要策略，但需基于预测因素识别消融后仍需起搏器的高危患者；所提风险分层框架有助于个体化选择消融、起搏或心脏神经消融，但预测阈值多来自回顾性研究，未来需前瞻性多中心研究验证整合预测模型。

summary_zh: 心动过速-心动过缓综合征（TBS）以室上性快速性心律失常（主要为心房颤动）终止后出现延长的窦性停搏为特征，目前有两种主要的根治策略：导管消融（CA）和起搏器植入（PMI）。当前指南（2024 ESC）推荐CA作为IIa类干预措施以改善症状并避免PMI。然而，相当比例的患者（7.4%-22.4%）在CA后仍需要PMI，主要归因于潜在的内在性窦房结功能障碍（SND）。已报道了若干CA后PMI的预测因素，包括术前心动过缓相关症状、校正窦房结恢复时间延长（cSNRT > 550 ms）、心动过速后停搏时间较长（> 6.3 s）、最长窦性停搏发生于日间、自主神经标志物如心率变异性（HRV）、右心房重构表现为右/左心房容积指数比值升高（RAVI/LAVI比值 > 0.812）、E/Em升高、心房或结周纤维化、房室传导疾病以及操作相关的窦房结动脉损伤。大多数提出的阈值来自回顾性或单中心队列，需要前瞻性外部验证。本综述总结了关于心房颤动（AF）与SND之间双向相互作用的当前证据，区分了可能可逆的AF介导或迷走神经介导的SND与内在性SND，并提出了一个实用的、以治疗为导向的风险分层框架。该框架将患者分为三种表型：可能仅通过CA即可改善的患者、CA后需要PMI高风险的患者，以及迷走神经介导的功能性SND可能适合心脏神经消融（CNA）的患者。新兴策略，包括CNA、传导系统起搏（CSP）、无导线起搏器（LPMs）和生物起搏器，可能进一步优化个体化管理。未来需要前瞻性多中心研究来验证整合预测模型。

title: Individual coverage of atrial fibrillation burden intervals from twenty sampled Holter minutes
summary: Analysis software for estimating atrial fibrillation burden from twenty sampled Holter minutes and assessing patient-level coverage of burden intervals.
journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

AI.tldr: 基于20个抽样Holter分钟估算房颤负荷的分析软件，可在患者个体层面评估负荷区间的覆盖情况。
AI.motivation: 房颤负荷通常需长程Holter或植入式监测评估，但摘要未报告既往证据缺口及具体临床问题。
AI.method: 研究类型为分析软件方法学研究；研究对象、样本量、抽样方案细节、终点定义及统计方法摘要均未报告。
AI.result: 摘要未报告任何关键数值、效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 该软件为利用20个抽样Holter分钟估算房颤负荷并提供患者层面区间覆盖评估的工具，但摘要缺乏验证数据，其对电生理实践的影响尚无法判断。

title: Artificial intelligence in electrocardiogram interpretation for cardiovascular diagnosis and risk prediction: a systematic review of evidence through May 2026.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Artificial intelligence-enabled electrocardiogram (ECG) analysis has expanded across cardiovascular diagnosis, monitoring, and risk prediction, but published studies vary in methodology, validation, and clinical applicability. We systematically reviewed AI applications in ECG interpretation for cardiovascular diagnosis and risk prediction to define the evidence available through May 2026.

METHODS: This systematic review followed PRISMA 2020. PubMed and the Cochrane Library were searched from database inception through May 2026 for original human studies evaluating artificial intelligence, machine learning, or deep learning applications in ECG-based cardiovascular detection, classification, diagnosis, monitoring, or risk prediction. Risk of bias was assessed using PROBAST. Because of substantial heterogeneity in study populations, ECG modalities, model architectures, validation strategies, and reported outcomes, findings were synthesized narratively.

RESULTS: A total of 108 studies were included. Arrhythmia detection, particularly atrial fibrillation (AF), was the most mature and frequently evaluated application domain. Benchmark-based studies commonly reported high apparent performance, whereas larger clinical cohorts and externally validated studies generally showed more moderate but more clinically credible estimates. The most common methodological limitations were concentrated in the analysis domain, particularly limited external validation, overfitting risk, unclear train-test separation, class imbalance, and incomplete reporting of calibration and robustness.

CONCLUSIONS: AI-enabled ECG interpretation shows strongest support for arrhythmia detection and automated ECG classification, while structural disease screening and prognostic modeling remain promising but less mature. Future studies should prioritize prospective, multicenter, externally validated, and workflow-integrated designs with transparent reporting, calibration assessment, cost-effectiveness evaluation, and equitable assessment across diverse populations.

AI.tldr: 系统综述纳入108项研究，AI心电图在房颤等心律失常检测中最成熟，但外部验证不足，结构性疾病筛查与预后模型尚不成熟。
AI.motivation: AI心电分析已广泛用于心血管诊断、监测与风险预测，但既往研究在方法学、验证策略与临床适用性上差异较大，缺乏对截至2026年5月证据的系统梳理，临床医生难以判断其真实可靠性。
AI.method: 遵循PRISMA 2020的系统综述，检索PubMed与Cochrane Library自建库至2026年5月的原始人体研究，纳入评估AI、机器学习或深度学习用于心电心血管检测、分类、诊断、监测或风险预测者，共纳入108项研究；采用PROBAST评估偏倚风险；因研究人群、心电模态、模型架构、验证策略与结局指标异质性大，采用叙述性综合而非定量合并。
AI.result: 心律失常检测尤其是AF是最成熟、评估最多的应用领域。基于基准数据集的研究普遍报告较高的表观性能，而更大规模临床队列与外部验证研究给出的估计更为温和但临床可信度更高。方法学局限主要集中在分析领域：外部验证有限、过拟合风险、训练-测试分离不清、类别不平衡，以及校准度与稳健性报告不完整。摘要未报告具体的效应量与95%CI。
AI.conclusion: AI心电解读在心律失常检测与自动心电图分类方面证据最强，结构性疾病筛查与预后建模虽有前景但仍不成熟。未来研究应优先开展前瞻性、多中心、外部验证并与临床工作流整合的设计，注重透明报告、校准度评估、成本效益分析及多样化人群的公平性评估；当前证据受限于外部验证不足与报告不完整，尚不足以支持广泛临床推广。

summary_zh:
背景：人工智能赋能的心电图（ECG）分析已扩展到心血管诊断、监测和风险预测领域，但已发表的研究在方法学、验证和临床适用性方面存在差异。我们系统综述了人工智能在心电图解读中用于心血管诊断和风险预测的应用，以界定截至2026年5月可获得的证据。

方法：本系统综述遵循PRISMA 2020。检索了PubMed和Cochrane Library从建库至2026年5月的文献，纳入评估人工智能、机器学习或深度学习在心电图为基础的心血管检测、分类、诊断、监测或风险预测中应用的原始人体研究。使用PROBAST评估偏倚风险。由于研究人群、心电图模态、模型架构、验证策略和报告结局存在显著异质性， findings采用叙述性综合。

结果：共纳入108项研究。心律失常检测，尤其是心房颤动（AF），是最成熟且最常被评估的应用领域。基于基准的研究通常报告较高的表观性能，而更大的临床队列和外部验证研究通常显示更中等但更具临床可信度的估计值。最常见的方法学局限性集中在分析领域，特别是外部验证有限、过拟合风险、训练-测试分离不明确、类别不平衡以及校准和稳健性报告不完整。

结论：人工智能赋能的心电图解读在心律失常检测和自动化心电图分类方面显示出最强支持，而结构性心脏病筛查和预后建模仍有前景但尚不成熟。未来研究应优先采用前瞻性、多中心、外部验证和整合工作流程的设计，并具备透明报告、校准评估、成本效益评估以及在多样化人群中的公平评估。

title: Early Right Ventricular Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillator Lead Microdislodgement Associated With Active-Fixation Helix Retraction: A Case Report
Extravascular Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillators in Children: Real World Evidence.
summary: The extravascular implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (EV-ICD) is a novel substernal ICD with limited reports in children and adolescents. Single-centre review of EV-ICDs in children <18-years. Clinical, peri-procedural, and electrocardiographic data reviewed, including device performance in routine exercise stress testing. Median follow-up 10.9 (IQR 7.5 - 12.5) months. Between April 2025-April 2026, 15 EV-ICDs were successfully implanted by a single cardiothoracic surgeon: median age 13.8-years, IQR 10.2-16.4; 11 (73%) male; weight 52 kg, IQR 38.2-64.1; BSA 1.6 m2, IQR 1.2-1.8. Smallest child was 4-years, 17.3 kg (BSA 0.7 m2). Indications were primary (n = 10) and secondary (n = 5) prevention. Underlying diagnoses included cardiomyopathy (n = 9), channelopathy (n = 3). One child had a previous sternotomy and another severe chest-wall deformity. Median anaesthetic time was 148 min (IQR 130-161), surgical time 68 min (59-88), fluoroscopy time 2.6 min (2.2-3.8). Median 3 (IQR 2-4) day hospitalisation. Two children experienced early complications. In one child, defibrillator threshold testing terminated ventricular fibrillation (VF) into ventricular tachycardia (VT) requiring CPR and a decision to use external cardioversion. The child fully recovered. One adolescent experienced profound bradycardia and syncope early post anaesthesia. R-wave amplitude at implant (5mV, IQR 4.2 - 6.7), discharge (5, IQR 2.8 - 8.1) and latest follow-up (5.8, IQR 3.2 - 13.7) was stable. Device sensing during routine exercise stress testing has been appropriate. There has been one successful appropriate high voltage therapy and no inappropriate high voltage therapy. This is the largest single-centre series internationally, demonstrating reliable paediatric EV-ICD implantation and short-term device performance. Ongoing paediatric surveillance is necessary.

AI.tldr: 儿童EV-ICD单中心15例植入显示手术可行、短期感知稳定，但围术期有2例并发症，需持续监测。
AI.motivation: 血管外植入式心律转复除颤器（EV-ICD）是新型胸骨下ICD，在儿童和青少年中报道有限，缺乏真实世界证据。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，纳入2025年4月至2026年4月植入EV-ICD的15例<18岁儿童，中位随访10.9个月。收集临床、围术期及心电图数据，包括常规运动负荷试验中的设备性能。
AI.result: 15例均成功植入，中位年龄13.8岁，最小4岁（17.3 kg，BSA 0.7 m²）。适应证一级预防10例、二级预防5例。中位麻醉时间148 min，手术时间68 min，透视时间2.6 min，住院3天。2例早期并发症：1例除颤阈值测试中VF终止为VT需CPR和外转复，另1例麻醉后严重心动过缓和晕厥。R波振幅在植入时、出院时和末次随访分别为5 mV、5 mV和5.8 mV，保持稳定。运动负荷试验中感知适当。1例成功接受适当高电压治疗，无不当高电压治疗。
AI.conclusion: 这是国际上最大的儿童EV-ICD单中心系列，显示儿童植入可靠且短期设备性能良好，但围术期并发症提示需持续儿科监测。

summary_zh: 血管外植入式心律转复除颤器（EV-ICD）是一种新型胸骨下ICD，在儿童和青少年中的报道有限。单中心回顾性分析18岁以下儿童中植入EV-ICD的病例。回顾临床、围手术期和心电图数据，包括常规运动负荷试验中的设备性能。中位随访10.9（IQR 7.5 - 12.5）个月。2025年4月至2026年4月期间，由单一心胸外科医生成功植入15例EV-ICD：中位年龄13.8岁，IQR 10.2-16.4；11例（73%）为男性；体重52 kg，IQR 38.2-64.1；体表面积1.6 m2，IQR 1.2-1.8。最小的儿童为4岁，17.3 kg（体表面积0.7 m2）。适应证为一级预防（n = 10）和二级预防（n = 5）。基础诊断包括心肌病（n = 9）、离子通道病（n = 3）。一名儿童有既往胸骨切开术史，另一名有严重胸壁畸形。中位麻醉时间148分钟（IQR 130-161），手术时间68分钟（59-88），透视时间2.6分钟（2.2-3.8）。中位住院3天（IQR 2-4）。两名儿童出现早期并发症。在一名儿童中，除颤阈值测试将心室颤动（VF）终止为室性心动过速（VT），需要心肺复苏并决定使用体外电复律。该儿童完全康复。一名青少年在麻醉后早期出现严重心动过缓和晕厥。植入时R波振幅（5mV，IQR 4.2 - 6.7）、出院时（5，IQR 2.8 - 8.1）和最近随访时（5.8，IQR 3.2 - 13.7）保持稳定。常规运动负荷试验中的设备感知一直适当。有一次成功的适当高压治疗，无不当高压治疗。这是国际上最大的单中心系列，证明儿童EV-ICD植入可靠且短期设备性能良好。有必要进行持续的儿科监测。

title: A pilot randomized feasibility trial of perioperative melatonin for cardiac arrhythmias during CPB weaning, sedative and analgesic medication use, and mechanical ventilation following CABG
Lower atmospheric pressure is associated with shallower radiofrequency ablation lesions and more frequent steam pops: an ex vivo porcine study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atmospheric pressure affects the boiling point of water and may influence thermal lesion formation during radiofrequency (RF) ablation. However, whether atmospheric pressure alters RF lesion formation and steam-pop risk under fixed ablation index (AI) targets remains unknown.

METHODS: A total of 360 analyzable lesions were created in 36 ex vivo porcine hearts using the same RF ablation system, which was transported and used consistently at three sites with different atmospheric pressures: Beijing (1,014 hPa), Xining (770 hPa), and Lhasa (650 hPa). At each site, 30 analyzable lesions were obtained at each target AI value (300, 400, 500, and 600). Lesion dimensions, impedance reduction, ablation duration, temperature, and steam-pop occurrence were recorded. Differences among sites were assessed using analysis of variance and Fisher's exact test. A multiple linear regression model was constructed to evaluate the relationship between atmospheric pressure, AI, and lesion volume.

RESULTS: At fixed AI targets, lesions created at lower-pressure sites were significantly shallower and had smaller volumes (all P < 0.05), whereas surface and maximum diameters remained similar among the three sites. Steam pops occurred in 0/120 (0.0%) RF applications in Beijing, 2/122 (1.6%) in Xining, and 6/126 (4.8%) in Lhasa (overall P = 0.031). Impedance reductions differed significantly among sites at 3 and 10 s (both P < 0.001), but not at 5 s (P = 0.498). Atmospheric pressure and AI jointly explained 88.4% of the variation in lesion volume (R2 = 0.884), enabling derivation of a hypothesis-generating AI correction equation.

CONCLUSION: Within the natural range of atmospheric pressures examined, lower atmospheric pressure was associated with shallower and smaller-volume RF lesions at fixed AI targets and a higher observed incidence of steam pops. These findings suggest that atmospheric pressure may influence RF lesion formation and steam-pop occurrence, warranting further mechanistic and in vivo validation.

AI.tldr: 在固定消融指数（AI）目标下，较低大气压与更浅、体积更小的射频消融灶及更高的蒸汽爆裂发生率相关。
AI.motivation: 大气压影响水的沸点，可能影响射频消融过程中的热损伤形成，但固定AI目标下大气压是否改变消融灶形成及蒸汽爆裂风险尚不明确。
AI.method: 离体猪心研究，共36颗猪心、360个可分析消融灶，使用同一射频消融系统在北京（1014 hPa）、西宁（770 hPa）和拉萨（650 hPa）三个不同大气压站点进行消融。每个站点在每个目标AI值（300、400、500、600）下获得30个可分析消融灶。记录消融灶尺寸、阻抗下降、消融时间、温度及蒸汽爆裂发生情况。采用方差分析和Fisher精确检验比较站点间差异，并构建多元线性回归模型评估大气压、AI与消融灶体积的关系。
AI.result: 在固定AI目标下，较低气压站点创建的消融灶显著更浅且体积更小（均P<0.05），而表面直径和最大直径在三个站点间保持相似。蒸汽爆裂发生率：北京0/120（0.0%）、西宁2/122（1.6%）、拉萨6/126（4.8%）（总体P=0.031）。阻抗下降在3秒和10秒时站点间差异显著（均P<0.001），但在5秒时无差异（P=0.498）。大气压和AI共同解释了消融灶体积变异的88.4%（R²=0.884），并推导出一个假设生成性的AI校正方程。
AI.conclusion: 在所研究的自然大气压范围内，较低大气压与固定AI目标下更浅、体积更小的射频消融灶及更高的蒸汽爆裂观察发生率相关。这些发现提示大气压可能影响射频消融灶形成和蒸汽爆裂发生，需要进一步的机制研究和在体验证。

summary_zh:
背景：大气压影响水的沸点，并可能影响射频（RF）消融过程中的热损伤形成。然而，在固定的消融指数（AI）目标下，大气压是否会改变RF损伤形成及蒸汽爆裂风险仍不清楚。

方法：使用同一RF消融系统在36只离体猪心中创建了共360个可分析的损伤，该系统被运送并在三个不同大气压的地点一致使用：北京（1,014 hPa）、西宁（770 hPa）和拉萨（650 hPa）。在每个地点，每个目标AI值（300、400、500和600）下获得30个可分析的损伤。记录损伤尺寸、阻抗下降、消融持续时间、温度和蒸汽爆裂发生情况。采用方差分析和Fisher精确检验评估地点间的差异。构建多元线性回归模型以评估大气压、AI与损伤体积之间的关系。

结果：在固定AI目标下，较低气压地点创建的损伤显著更浅且体积更小（所有P < 0.05），而表面直径和最大直径在三个地点间保持相似。蒸汽爆裂在北京的0/120（0.0%）次RF应用中发生，西宁为2/122（1.6%），拉萨为6/126（4.8%）（总体P = 0.031）。阻抗下降在3秒和10秒时地点间差异显著（均P < 0.001），但在5秒时无显著差异（P = 0.498）。大气压和AI共同解释了损伤体积变异的88.4%（R2 = 0.884），从而能够推导出一个假设生成性的AI校正方程。

结论：在所检查的自然大气压范围内，较低大气压与固定AI目标下更浅且体积更小的RF损伤以及观察到的更高蒸汽爆裂发生率相关。这些发现表明大气压可能影响RF损伤形成和蒸汽爆裂发生，值得进一步的机制研究和体内验证。
